briefing.text: Information Technology stays #1 on News, X and Reddit (buzz 88.3, 93.6 and 94.1), driven by NVDA, CRWV, AMD and MU. News mentions for it fell 12% on the day (sentiment 0.27) and X mentions fell 23%, while Reddit mentions rose 34% with flat sentiment (-0.01); week-on-week buzz is up only 0.4 to 1.5 points. On News, Financials climbed from #11 to #6 (buzz 81.7, +6.1 on the day, +6.9 on the week) led by BAC, UBS, MS and JPM, even though mentions dropped 43%. Health Care slipped #3 to #4 (buzz -1.8, mentions -38%) and Real Estate #9 to #10 (buzz -2.3). On Reddit, Health Care rose #6 to #4 (buzz +3.7, tickers MRNA, SLS, NVO) and Utilities buzz rose 3.4 on VST, EIX and NEE (mentions +22%).

NVDA #1: heavy coverage (1,895 articles in 2 days, 471 negative vs 253 positive), with headlines on an Nvidia CEO resignation and chip-stock moves; it explains the high attention and volume.
TTWO #2: BofA says GTA VI needs a $1.9bn opening weekend to meet investor expectations; this fits the high attention and X attention.
CRWV #3: 678 articles, mostly positive (490 vs 87), including CoreWeave vs Nebius and AI-spending debate pieces; supports the ranking.
COST #6: 95 articles with little negative tone (44 positive, 2 negative), but the headlines are generic, so news only weakly explains the rank.
DRAM #7: Micron and TSMC shares fell on Nvidia shake-up news after a memory rally; this matches its high attention.
SE #8: shares hit a new 52-week low after an analyst downgrade; only 13 articles, so news is a modest driver.
KDP #9: stock tumbling and a $2B stock offering to cut debt; 16 of 22 articles negative, which explains its large price move (3.4 sigma).
NDX #10: mostly 13F filing and ETF screener items; generic, does not explain the rank.

NVDA ranks first (score 0.933) on volume at 4.2x normal (top percentile), attention 1.33x normal, and a catalyst of earnings on 11-17; its X attention is lower at 0.77x. TTWO is second (0.905) almost entirely on attention: 1.56x normal overall and 1.65x on X, with only 0.71x volume and a small move, and no dated catalyst. CRWV is third (0.877) on attention 1.36x, X attention 1.15x, volume near 0.93x and a 5-day gain of 22%, with a KPI market resolving soon.

notes: Ranks are by the scoring of record (pick_rank, w2). Prices and moves as of the last pull of the day. Facts from public data; not investment advice.
